purpose: Quaternius character test (#10029): one innkeeper with a painted face set and clothing/texture variants. A test aid placed by craft.style.* debug commands, not shipped content.

sources.packs: Quaternius Universal Base Characters (Standard) and Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy (Standard), CC0 1.0 (their License_Standard.txt); Patch-provided, archived at /data/rusty-craftsurvive-old/local/
sources.head: Base Characters/Godot - UE/Superhero_Female_FullBody.gltf, cut to head and neck; Eyes and Eyebrows meshes dropped, eye and mouth holes capped

outfits.innkeeper-mountain: Modular Parts/Female_Ranger_Body, Arms, Legs, Feet, Head_Hood (no hair)

sources.clips: content/animations/UAL1_Standard.glb (Quaternius UAL1, CC0) Idle_Loop, Walk_Loop, Idle_Talking_Loop, retargeted onto the Quaternius rig by authoring/tools/characters/quaternius/retarget.py

paint.method: asset-pipeline tools/texture-edit/view_paint.py render (4 orthographic views) -> Qwen-Image-2.1 edits (tools/texture-edit/qwen_edit.py, owner RTX 5090) -> authoring/tools/characters/quaternius/paint_bake.py
paint.face: authoring/tools/characters/quaternius/face_slot.py base render, repainted by Qwen (seed 3, prompt in /data/rusty-craftsurvive-old/docs/evidence/quaternius-10029/paint/face/neutral-prompt.txt); hair recoloured in code; blink, talk and smile are single Qwen edits of the neutral face (seed 4)

build: authoring/tools/characters/quaternius/build_variant.sh <name> <recipe> <body-material> <prompt> (innkeeper was built step by step with the same scripts before build_variant.sh existed)
